rows: cutlass/ (v4.8.0, include/cutlass/version.h)

NVIDIA CUTLASS, whole checkout. Only examples/python/CuTeDSL/ and python/CuTeDSL/ matter: the first is the example corpus a port starts from, the second is the DSL's own source, which is worth more than the examples — signatures, LaunchConfig fields and env-var handling are all readable there, and guessing at them costs a GPU run each.

the CuTe DSL API surface at 4.8, the Blackwell example kernels (dense/blockscaled/grouped GEMM, attention), the cute_ext pipeline + epilogue helpers, blockscaled_layout.BlockScaledBasicChunk (the ue8m0 / nvfp4 scale atom), and utils/blackwell_helpers.py
sage_sm120 and any future CuTeDSL kernel
265 MB. examples/python/CuTeDSL/ is ~4 MB and python/CuTeDSL/cutlass/ ~10 MB; include/, test/ and tools/ are the rest and are C++ that informs nothing here.

thu-ml's official SageAttention / SageAttention2++ / SageAttention3 — quantized attention as hand-written CUDA (mma.sync + cp.async + swizzled smem), plus Triton fallbacks and the fused quantizers.
the SageAttention3 arithmetic and CuTe layout abstractions
